visualReview.method: Assistant inspected the actual returned PNG pixels.

checks.evidence: A river and a low central bridge are visibly present.
Layered green hills sit beneath an orange and yellow sky.
The lower portion of the original square image is largely empty.

checks.requirement: No people, animals, words or decorative frame
checks.evidence: None of these were visible in the inspected image.
The returned PNG is 1024 by 1024 pixels despite requesting a wide landscape.

limitations: This is one synthetic sample, not proof of consistent model adherence.
Cropping a square backdrop to the stage can remove part of the foreground; backdrop fit must preserve the intended composition.

refinements: Count spoken dialogue lines separately from stage directions in the AI request.
Omit unchanged story fields from editable proposals to preserve focused revisions.
